SHIRE OF WAROONA

NOTICE OF SPECIAL COUNCIL MEETING

A Special Meeting of the Council will be held on Thursday 19 August, 2021 commencing at 5.00 pm in the Council Chambers to deliberate on the following matters –

  1. CEO Recruitment Panel – Terms of Reference 2021
  2. CEO Recruitment Panel – Confidentiality Agreement 2021

Council Meetings

The Shire of Waroona Council will be holding Ordinary Council Meetings on the fourth Tuesday of every month commencing at 4:00pm unless otherwise stated.

Any member of the public can ask a question or make a deputation within an Ordinary Council Meeting.

Application forms must be completed in full and submitted to the Chief Executive Officer by 2pm of the day of the Ordinary Council Meeting. These can be emailed to eso@waroona.wa.gov.au or dropped off at the Shire Administration Buiding at 52 Hesse Street, Waroona.

Click on the below links for the application forms.

CGF005 – Application to make a Deputation at an Ordinary Council Meeting

CGF006 – Application for Public Question Time at an Ordinary Council Meeting

 All Council and Committee meetings are audio recorded and made public in accordance with r.14J of the Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996.

Agendas and Appendices are uploaded to this website approximately 7 days before each council meeting. Minutes and Audio Recordings of each meeting are uploaded within 2 days of a council meeting. They can be found by clicking on the council meeting dates below.

If you require this document in an alternative format, such as large print or a coloured background, please contact the Shire of Waroona Administration Office via phone on (08) 9733 7800 or via email warshire@waroona.wa.gov.au

If you have any queries in relation to Council Meetings please do not hesitate to contact Council's Executive Assistant Merrin Kirk on 9733 7800 or email: eso@waroona.wa.gov.au.
